verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an official SDK for building your own frontend or backend on top of Base44 as a backend service. The docs show an entities module with CRUD operations and code examples such as base44.entities.Task.create, and the docs homepage positions the SDK alongside the CLI and managed backend. Missing for 10: evidence of more than one language or runtime SDK, a published API spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK in use.
